sn22.53:1.3: This is speaking of the consciousness that “remains” or “lasts” in transmigration ([dn33:1.11.122](), [sn22.54:1.11]()). Pali uses the same word _viññāṇaṭṭhiti_ for the seven “planes of consciousness” (realms of rebirth, [an7.44](), [dn15:33.1]()) as for the four “grounds for consciousness”, namely the other four aggregates on which consciousness is based.
